To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the orbital-relevant d-wave nematic charge order, the spin nematic order and the pairing s-wave superconducting order can all stem from one microscopic mechanism that is reduction of the Hubbard interaction energy by virtual hopping processes.
the electronic nematicity is a strong-coupling effect from the reduction of the Hubbard energies in the particle-hole channels.
we propose a strong-coupling mechanism for the electronic nematicity and the superconductivity in Fe-based superconductor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the driving force of electronic nematicity which is a key ingredient for understanding the mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity in Fe-based superconductor.
the electronic nematicity and its driving force in Fe-based superconductor.
the electronic nematicity and its relation to the spin magnetic and the superconducting orders in the Fe-based superconductivity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the orbital-relevant charge nematic order in iron-based superconductors is the consequence of a strong-coupling mechanism that is a reduction of the Hubbard interaction by virtual hopping processes in the particle-hole channel.
the electronic nematicity is a driving force of the superconductivity.

all these three orders in the Fe-based superconducting systems are the consequence of reduction of the Hubbard energies by virtual hopping processes in particle-hole charge, particle-hole spin and particle-particle pairing channels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electronic nematicity can be viewed as a precursor of superconducting order parameter and it is a necessary condition for the occurrence of superconductivity.

the electronic nematicity is a general phenomenon in the unconventional superconductors, and it is the precursor for the pairing superconductors and can also co-exist with the pairing superconductivities in some cases.

the driving force for the electronic nematicity is the reduction of large Hubbard energies in the electronic charge and spin channels, which are the same for the driving force of pairing superconductivity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electronic nematicity can be a key ingredient in the mechanism of unconventional superconductivity.
the electronic nematicity can be a driving force for the spin magnetism or the pairing superconducticity in unconventional superconductivity.
the electronic nematicity is not only a secondary order parameter in unconventional superconductivity but it is the driving force for the pairing mechanism.
